critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py is 1965 lines — exceeds the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting agent-tasks, engine-runtime proxy, gpu-admin and media-job routes into separate routers for maintainability.

AgentTaskIn.duration defaults to None at the task layer; the 5s/15s engine-rule defaults are only applied downstream in create_media_job via engine_rules.default_duration. The agent_tasks row therefore stores duration=None, which is correct per spec but could surprise an API consumer polling /api/chat/agents/tasks/{id} before dispatch; consider echoing the resolved duration on the task row too.

GET /api/engines/rules shape differs from a conventional list: top-level has {summary:[...], engines:{id:{...}}} (dict keyed by id). This is fine but should be documented in the /developers page so API consumers don't key off engines[0].
Chain state size limit 64KB is enforced correctly (413), but the error body is a short detail — consider including the observed size so callers can trim programmatically.
